Existing model test expects grey after starting a Resumed broadcast without chunks, contrary to the issue requirements. Project source and tests remain untouched.

Verification: Existing `VoiceBroadcastPlayback-test.ts` passes (40/40); its expectations encode the old behavior and do not cover the requested mapping or event stability. Likely fix points are a new `utils/determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness.ts` utility and `models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts`, with model tests updated for all info states and playback transitions. Unknown info events are currently filtered by `addInfoEvent`; confirm whether the requested fallback applies only to the utility or also to invalid incoming events.
